story_overview: Emperor Jinyang is mysteriously distressed as a suit of armor is displayed in the palace. A nobleman, Caspian, arrives in a rural village, alarming a local woman, Lian. Their paths cross in a series of tense encounters surrounding the enigmatic ornate shadow armor, which seems to pass from person to person.

video_prompts:
Jinyang: Older man with long, graying hair and a goatee, wearing an ornate black and red outer robe over a pink garment, and a small golden crown.
Gunnar: Weathered, middle-aged man with a stocky, muscular build, a rugged face with a thick, dark, untrimmed beard, and long, matted hair tied back, wearing a dark, worn leather jerkin over a chainmail shirt, heavy trousers, and scuffed, knee-high leather boots, with studded leather bracers on his forearms and a wide belt with a sheathed dagger at the hip.
The Imperial Hall: Grand indoor palace chamber with high, ornate ceilings, lacquered wooden columns, walls with large silk tapestries and calligraphy scrolls, and a raised dais with a large, intricately carved imperial throne.
the ornate shadow armor: Full suit of heavy, dark, ornate plate armor with a matching full-face helmet, all constructed from a dark, possibly blackened, metal and featuring elaborate, intricate designs etched across its surface.
the black dragon robe: Ornate, floor-length black silk robe with a high collar, wide bell sleeves, and intricate red and gold embroidered dragon motifs on the chest, back, and cuffs
the green patterned screen: Large, multi-panel screen in a traditional East Asian style, with dark wood borders and panels decorated with an intricate, repeating green pattern

Jinyang, wearing the black dragon robe and the small golden crown, stands before the ornate shadow armor with a distressed expression. He dabs his mouth with the fine white cloth, then looks down with a somber look. In the background, Gunnar stands silently by the green patterned screen, his arms crossed as he observes Jinyang.
action_descriptions: Jinyang, wearing the black dragon robe and the small golden crown, stands before the ornate shadow armor with a distressed expression. He dabs his mouth with the fine white cloth, then looks down with a somber look. In the background, Gunnar stands silently by the green patterned screen, his arms crossed as he observes Jinyang.

Caspian: Man in heavy, ornate dark armor with teal and gold details, wearing a helmet.
The Village Common: An open town square in a rural village, defined by rustic buildings of wood and stone construction and an unpaved central road.
the brown warhorse: Large, muscular brown horse with a dark mane and tail, outfitted with leather riding tack including a saddle and bridle.
the leaf-bladed spears: Military spears with long, dark-stained wooden shafts and polished, leaf-shaped steel heads.

Caspian, wearing his heavy, ornate dark armor and mounted on the brown warhorse, leads a procession of guards wearing armor in the style of the crescent moon plate armor and carrying the leaf-bladed spears. The camera follows them as they ride through the town square, passing a group of apprehensive villagers including Lian, Rhys, Bram, and Gunnar, who watch from the roadside. At the end of the shot, one guard raises his spear threateningly.

the weathered thatch roof: Thickly layered roof of dried, weathered thatch with a rough, uneven texture and a mix of tan and brown colors.

Medium close-up of Lian, wearing the rust-colored robe, in The Village Common, her expression growing worried as she looks upward. She stands in front of a wooden building topped with the weathered thatch roof. Rhys steps up just behind her, also looking up.
